evidence.title: NorForge reports malicious tasks on at least 17 exposed panels, including malware executed by agents.
evidence.observation: NorForge reports malicious tasks on at least 17 exposed panels, including malware executed by agents. Some tasks disappeared during observation.

source_locations.SRC-048: The Baddening; The Access; The Malware; autonomy discussion

evidence.limitations: Container escape success was not established. Automation evidence and naming patterns do not prove autonomous initiation; pauses suggested human involvement. Attribution to two activity clusters is provisional, and legitimate panels were also affected.
evidence.open_questions: Underlying raw traces and all alternatives have not been independently checked by the Commons.
evidence.support_assessment: Attributed bounded finding; publication inclusion does not certify truth or completeness. Distinct later campaign against Cairn. Publication shares investigator and earlier panel context with NOR_CAIRN, not independent corroboration. No leaked secrets or panels retrieved. No identical source/case in baseline v0.4.1; repeated media/report references merge to this source/case rather than independent corroboration.

terms.name: Cross-system feedback
terms.definition: A pattern in which an action or output from one technical or organizational process affects activity elsewhere and subsequent responses modify conditions for additional participants. Many response paths may exist; there need not be a single linear loop.

terms.name: Governability
terms.definition: A property of a consequential process describing the extent to which legitimate parties can understand, influence, constrain, correct, or recover its operation and outcomes. It does not imply complete predictability or a single controller.

terms.name: Observability boundary
terms.definition: The practical limit of what a given observer or monitoring arrangement can detect, interpret, or causally connect. The limit may be known, partly understood, or itself unrecognized.
